verdict.rationale: Companies House's own GOV.UK page carries guidance on "when you need to verify your identity" (supp-3), and its service listings use plain task language such as "file certain documents online instead of posting a paper form" (docs-17, docs-18). This shows some first-party plain-language guidance. Nothing in the evidence shows step-by-step explainers for founder tasks, and the GOV.UK set-up-business page (probe-2) is the host platform's guidance rather than the agency's own, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: evidenced step-by-step walkthroughs for founder tasks such as incorporating, filing accounts or confirmation statements; evidence that the guidance is written for non-lawyers rather than citing statute and form numbers; independent or hands-on corroboration of its clarity.
